events.quote: In English the order is subject, then verb, then object.
Rule: say the subject first, then the verb, then the object; place or time goes last.
Right: Omar kicks the ball in the park. Wrong: Kicks Omar the ball in the park.
The rule: use at before a clock time.
Rule: Start a sentence with a capital letter and end it with a full stop.
Right: Our neighbour has a red car. Wrong: our neighbour has a red car
Rule: say who first, then the action, then the thing.
Right: Mia reads books. Wrong: Reads Mia books.
